  - strong reward for bearing off
  - reward for entering from bar and penalty for staying on bar
  - reward for hitting opponent blots
  - penalty for leaving blots, especially in range of enemy hitters
  - reward for made points, primes, anchors, and home-board strength
  - reward for race improvement in low-contact positions
